blocks.prompt: 9 Given that: \(\int_{0}^{9} f(x)\,dx = 16\) and \(\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 12\). Evaluate the integral \(\int_{3}^{9} \big(2f(x) + 5\big)\,dx\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh do qadam ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \([0, 9]\) par integral 16 aur \([0, 3]\) par 12.
Find kya karna hai? \([3, 9]\) par \(2f(x) + 5\) ka integral.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle Property III se \(\int_3^9 f\) nikalenge. Phir Property IX (linearity) se \(\int (2f + 5)\) ko \(2\int f + \int 5\) mein torenge.
Plan: \(\int_3^9 f\), torna, constant ka integral, jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{0}^{9} f(x)\,dx = 16\), \(\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 12\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{3}^{9} \big(2f(x) + 5\big)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property III se \(\int_3^9 f\); Property IX \(\int (\alpha f_1 + \beta f_2) = \alpha\int f_1 + \beta\int f_2\).

\(\int_3^9 f\) nikalein
\[16 = 12 + \int_{3}^{9} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\int_{3}^{9} f(x)\,dx = 4\]
Kyun: Property III se \(\int_0^9 = \int_0^3 + \int_3^9\), kyunke \(0 < 3 < 9\). Dono taraf se 12 minus kiya.

Maloom karne wale integral ko torein
\[\int_{3}^{9} \big(2f(x) + 5\big)\,dx = 2\int_{3}^{9} f(x)\,dx + \int_{3}^{9} 5\,dx\]
Kyun: Property IX: jama ka integral integrals ka jama hai, aur constant 2 bahar aa jata hai.

Hal karein
\[= 2(4) + \Big[5x\Big]_{3}^{9}\]
\[= 8 + (45 - 15) = 38\]
Kyun: \(\int_3^9 5\,dx = 5 \times (9 - 3) = 30\); constant ka integral constant times interval ki lambai.
Dhyan dein: \(\int_3^9 5\,dx\) ko sirf 5 likh dena aam ghalti hai; lambai 6 se multiply zaroori hai.

Tasdeeq
\[2(4) + 5(6) = 38 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2f\) ka hissa 8 aur 5 ka hissa 30; jama 38. Answer key mein bhi 38 hai.
